content.text:
I changed the `TokenInterceptorException` handler in `TokenEndpoint.java` so a rejected resource indicator now logs an event. The module compiles. I didn't run any tests.

Previously the handler only returned the 400 response, so nothing reached the event log. It now sets the event's `reason` detail to the exception's description and records the rejected `resource` form parameter as a detail. It then calls `event.error(e.getError())`, which logs `invalid_target` for these failures. I also added the `OAuth2Constants` import.

I used the exception's own error code (`invalid_target`) rather than adding a new `Errors` constant. If you'd rather have a dedicated constant or `invalid_request`, that's a one-line change.

The graph had no index for this repo, so I used grep to find the code. I did not log this in the dogfood findings file.
